findings.evidence: The summary characterizes minimal parabolics as stabilizers of a single partial flag without specifying its type. Unrestricted partial-flag stabilizers include every standard parabolic; a flag with one proper subspace instead gives a maximal proper parabolic. In GL4, the line stabilizer P_{ {2,3} } strictly contains P_{ {2} } above B. The opened ex-standard-parabolics-in-gl-n, Example and Verification 3.1, distinguishes these classes and retains the n<=2 caveat. Specify the flag type. This objection is interpretation-sensitive; B-page prose is outside reader edit authority.
